# Stage 1: clean up noise
    kernel_small = np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8)
    thresh_clean = cv2.morphologyEx(thresh, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, kernel_small)

    # Stage 2: heavily dilate to merge ink marks into region blobs.
    # A large kernel bridges gaps between woodcut strokes; text lines remain
    # thin horizontal blobs that the aspect ratio filter rejects.
    kernel_large = np.ones((40, 40), np.uint8)
    thresh_blobs = cv2.dilate(thresh_clean, kernel_large, iterations=1)

    if debug:
        debug_path = os.path.join(output_dir, f"{Path(image_path).stem}_threshold.png")
        cv2.imwrite(debug_path, thresh_clean)
        print(f"  [DEBUG] Saved threshold image: {debug_path}")
        blobs_path = os.path.join(output_dir, f"{Path(image_path).stem}_blobs.png")
        cv2.imwrite(blobs_path, thresh_blobs)
        print(f"  [DEBUG] Saved blobs image: {blobs_path}")

    # Find contours on the blob version; crops come from the original image
    contours, hierarchy = cv2.findContours(
        thresh_blobs, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE
    )
